headline: Spain's relentless possession game overwhelms a resilient Argentina side in a rematch of recent Copa América heartbreak.

rounds.label: Round of 32
rounds.note: Mexico's perfect group stage form and Germany's defensive solidity anchor a round where established powers like France, Argentina, and Brazil navigate past overmatched opponents despite mixed qualifying form.

rounds.label: Round of 16
rounds.note: France and Spain's creative depth dispatches stubborn contenders, while England and Argentina advance through clinical finishing, leaving Netherlands and Belgium to rue their group-stage inconsistency.

rounds.label: Quarter-finals
rounds.note: Spain's midfield control suffocates England's attacking threats, and Argentina's tournament experience edges past a Brazil side that never quite found its rhythm after early draws.

rounds.label: Semi-finals
rounds.note: Spain dismantles France's aging core with superior ball retention and pressing intensity, while Argentina scrapes past England on penalties after a tense, tactical affair.

rounds.label: Final
rounds.note: Spain's possession dominance and pressing triggers Argentina's turnovers in key moments, converting chances with clinical efficiency to capture their second World Cup title and avenge recent tournament disappointments.
